protocol.word_order_32bit: LSB first, MSB second (value = MSB << 16 | LSB)
notes: Reading an address the controller does not implement returns SILENCE, not an IllegalDataAddress exception - a wrong address is indistinguishable from a dead link and costs a full timeout.
A block read succeeds only if EVERY address in it exists.
The controller accepts one client and one outstanding request at a time; pipelining makes it stop answering entirely.

semantics.capability_vs_register_presence: Capability limits are a FILTER, not a statement about which addresses respond. Every HP1-HP10 and Zone1-Zone4 register answers on any controller; unfitted ones read 0. Use the controller's max_heat_pumps/max_zones to decide what to POLL, and nonzero data to decide what is actually FITTED.
semantics.presence_detection: 'Is this heat pump fitted?' is answered by nonzero data, not by whether the register responds. Note -9999/-10000 is numerically nonzero but means the OPPOSITE - no sensor - so exclude the sentinels before counting.
semantics.units: INFERRED from each description; the manual gives only a scale factor. Treat as a hint.

controllers.description: Single heat pump control for CTC EcoAir (air/water).
notes: Brochure states one heat pump and gives no heating-system count; max_zones is null rather than guessed.
The brochure never mentions Modbus TCP (only myUplink/internet). Whether the BMS register map applies to EcoLogic S is UNVERIFIED.

controllers.description: Single heat pump control for CTC EcoPart (ground source).
notes: Same caveats as ecologic_s_ea: zone count unstated, Modbus TCP support unverified.

controllers.description: Smaller systems: up to 2 heat pumps, 2 heating systems.
Large installations: up to 10 heat pumps, 4 heating systems, pool, solar, cooling.
Maximum capacity: everything L has, plus active ground source cooling and dual tank sensors.
